scope: Deliberate opening and camera travel with immediate gesture commitment
evidenceNotes: All five new timing regressions fail the fast published baseline and pass the candidate. Response latency and travel duration are verified separately.
The initial isolated run passes 18/20. Two arrival-observation fixtures are corrected and pass 2/2 with unchanged application bytes. Original failures remain retained.

Independent isolated cold profiles show a largest phone hinge step of 1.89 degrees versus 30.01 previously. A cold callback delay remains; no general renderer-throughput or physical-device guarantee is inferred.
The camera now advances through floating tween coordinates while native position mirrors it. Exact arrivals, input latching, reversal and ordinary reading are retained.
26 of 28 assets, including both PDFs, remain byte-identical. Publication and hosted verification pending.
